name: Cinematic Warm
description: General cinematic starting-point grade based on 'The Grade Free' v1.13.1 by Zay's Aesthetics. WARNING: The author states this is a starting point requiring manual adjustment of node 02 (colour space transform), node 03 (exposure), and node 04 (white balance) per clip. Our automated pipeline applies it unattended, which may produce inconsistent results.
